lessons.title: Why People Buy
lessons.content: Sales psychology studies why people buy. Core truth: humans decide emotionally and justify rationally. The limbic system (emotion) decides; the neocortex (logic) rationalizes. KEY CONCEPTS: Reach the emotional driver, then arm the buyer with logic. The six core buying emotions: fear, greed, pride, guilt, hope, belonging. WORKED EXAMPLE: A luxury car buyer cites 'safety' (logic) but is driven by status (emotion). PRACTICE: 1) Identify the emotion behind a recent purchase. 2) List the logical reason you told others. 3) Note the gap.
